alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:75d81d67-4.title: Account Executive - Enterprise
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:75d81d67-4.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to help build and scale Baseten’s Enterprise go-to-market motion. You’ll own new business in verticals where AI adoption is accelerating including enterprise software, financial services, and big tech. This is a high-autonomy role where you’ll contribute directly to our Enterprise GTM strategy—identifying new use cases within your verticals, winning lighthouse customers that become references for their industries, and feeding signal back to product and engineering to shape our roadmap. You’ll work alongside Baseten’s founders, forward-deployed engineering team, and GTM leadership. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own a revenue target and all aspects of the sales cycle from prospecting to close, including outbounding and engaging Tier 1 accounts in your assigned verticals - Drive new logo acquisition and strategic expansion within key accounts, prioritizing organizations that can serve as lighthouse customers within their industries - Become a trusted advisor to customers—understand their unique infrastructure needs, co-innovate on solutions, and lead with conviction by providing clear recommendations grounded in deep industry expertise - Partner with Baseten’s forward-deployed engineers to run technical evaluations, POCs, and architecture reviews that earn customer confidence - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Marketing to bring new solutions to market, develop sales collateral, and refine go-to-market tactics for industry verticals - Continuously share learnings with the broader team—what’s working, what’s blocking deals, and best practices for selling into complex organizations WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 8+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience in technology, preferably selling infrastructure, API/platform solutions, or developer tooling into large, complex organizations - A track record of managing complex sales cycles and closing seven- and eight-figure deals by navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees and crafting tailored solutions - Experience selling into at least one of: financial services, healthcare/life sciences, insurance, government, or similarly regulated industries - Strong technical acumen - you have experience ramping into highly technical sales environments, and will be able to get comfortable holding your own in conversations about model serving, GPU infra, latency and API architecture. - A strategic, analytical approach to assessing markets combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities - Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships from ICs to C-level executives - A roll-up-your-sleeves mentality and comfort with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment where the playbook is still being written NICE TO HAVE - Direct experience selling AI/ML infrastructure, cloud compute, or model deployment platforms BENEFITS - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity. - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!) - Paid parental leave - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot - Company-facilitated 401(k) - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunitie

axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:be43ba8.title: Analytics Engineer
axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:be43ba8.description: ABOUT US At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here https://www.axle.energy/blog/analysis/power-of-the-home. ABOUT THE ROLE Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we are looking for someone to help run and optimise the rhythms at the heart of the business. We are looking for someone to develop a deep understanding of flexibility markets across the UK, who can collaborate cross-functionally, crunch numbers, and own critical daily and monthly operational processes. Owning daily operations means sitting at the heart of the ‘Axle control room’. This involves running and optimising the most critical operations processes in the business: asset management, trading across UK flexibility markets, and ultimately ensuring our clients and end customers get paid for the flex they deliver. A note on the job title: Analytics engineering is often closely associated with dbt. We don't use dbt at Axle because our data set up doesn't require a full ETL framework. Instead, this role is centred on the core analytics engineering skill set: developing a deep understanding of source data and building the data pipelines that power our analytics. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING - Owning operations for our UK energy trading (e.g. daily trading processes, reviewing settlements) - Debugging complex edge cases across our trading, asset registration and settlement processes - Identifying risks to revenue and delivery and proactively mitigate them - Communicating insights and actions clearly to engineering and commercial teams - Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders in Distribution System Operators (DSOs) and UK market regulators IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD - Strong SQL and Python skills for analysing data, investigating issues, and automating processes - Strong analytical skills: you’ll be speaking MW, kWh, and £ every day - A deep-seated motivation to combat climate change - Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment BENEFITS A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity). We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. INTERVIEW PROCESS 1. Initial interview 2. Take-home exercise 3. Final interview (in-person) 4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

jobgether-jobgether:lever:264353c0-c6a5-.title: Senior Finance Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:264353c0-c6a5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Finance Analyst based in the United States. This is an opportunity to play a key role in supporting financial performance within a large, fast-moving supply chain environment. You’ll turn financial and operational data into clear insights that help leaders make better business decisions. The role combines budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, reporting, and KPI tracking with a strong focus on continuous improvement. You’ll work closely with business stakeholders to investigate cost drivers, identify savings opportunities, and improve financial processes. Your analyses will directly contribute to operational efficiency, cost control, and the organization’s broader financial health. The environment is collaborative and performance-driven, offering autonomy while providing the resources and support needed to grow. This role is well suited to a detail-oriented finance professional who enjoys solving problems and turning complex data into actionable recommendations. Design, prepare, and maintain sophisticated Excel spreadsheets and cost models supporting resource planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. Prepare monthly financial reporting packages comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts for management review. Investigate significant cost variances and collaborate with business stakeholders to identify root causes, financial drivers, and opportunities for cost reduction. Identify, measure, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and other operational and financial metrics. Conduct ad hoc financial and budgetary investigations to address emerging business questions and support decision-making. Develop insightful, actionable analyses that clearly explain financial performance, trends, and underlying business drivers. Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, enhance the quality of financial information, and streamline report production and distribution. Troubleshoot reporting issues, investigate data anomalies, and ensure financial information is accurate, consistent, and reliable. Design clear, concise, professional reports that are easy for stakeholders to interpret, update, and distribute. Partner effectively with cross-functional teams while balancing independent analysis with collaborative problem-solving. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying ways to make financial processes and reporting more efficient. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of related professional or military experience. At least 2 years of experience in audit, accounting, FP&A, or a closely related financial function. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office. A degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline is preferred. Four or more years of relevant experience, particularly in budgeting and forecasting, is advantageous. Strong analytical skills with the ability to develop detailed, accurate, and actionable interpretations of financial and operational results. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly to different audiences. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies, anomalies, and meaningful financial trends. Ability to quickly learn and become proficient in new software applications and reporting tools. Self-motivated and comfortable working independently with limited supervision while also contributing effectively within a team. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Benefits: Competitive compensation. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. 401(k) retirement savings plan. Life insurance. Disability insurance. Full-time schedule, Monday through Friday, 8:0

jobgether-jobgether:lever:a3b2d84a-7a41-.title: Solutions Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a3b2d84a-7a41-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Engineer based in United States. This role owns the technical dimension of the sales process across North America, helping hospitality businesses understand how a modern technology platform can fit into their existing environment. You will act as a trusted technical partner to commercial teams and customers throughout complex SMB and Mid-Market sales cycles. Your expertise will help hotel operators evaluate integrations, payment capabilities, APIs, PMS workflows, and broader technology architecture. You’ll translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations for audiences ranging from IT specialists to hotel general managers. The role combines consultative selling, technical discovery, solution design, and customer engagement in a fast-growing SaaS environment. You’ll collaborate closely with sales and other solutions professionals while also helping strengthen the technical capabilities of commercial teams. Success requires strong hospitality knowledge, commercial awareness, communication skills, and a proactive approach to using AI to improve how work gets done. Act as the lead technical partner for SMB and Mid-Market sales opportunities, supporting commercial teams throughout the sales cycle. Explain integrations, payment capabilities, APIs, and technical functionality clearly to hotel operators and technical stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise. Participate in regular opportunity and pipeline alignment meetings to stay closely connected to active sales initiatives and provide timely technical guidance. Conduct consultative technical discovery and help sales teams position solutions that align with customer requirements and business objectives. Help customers evaluate how the platform fits within their existing hospitality technology ecosystem, including PMS workflows, integrations, payment infrastructure, and property-level systems. Translate complex technical architectures and integration considerations into accessible recommendations that support confident purchasing decisions. Serve as a technical resource across the customer lifecycle, helping bridge pre-sales positioning with post-sales implementation and customer needs. Partner closely with sales and other solutions professionals across North America to ensure consistent technical guidance and effective deal execution. Train and develop sales teammates by sharing technical knowledge, best practices, and practical approaches to technical discovery and solution positioning. Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, technical enablement, and customer outcomes through stronger solution architecture and effective use of AI. Requirements Ideally 5+ years of experience in solutions architecture, sales engineering, technical account management, or a comparable customer-facing technical role within SaaS or technology organizations. Strong hospitality or hotel-technology experience, with a practical understanding of hotel operations, PMS workflows, integrations, and the technology decisions that affect day-to-day property operations. Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, from IT and technical stakeholders to hotel general managers and business leaders. Strong commercial awareness and comfort operating within a sales environment, with an understanding of deal dynamics, customer priorities, and business outcomes. Experience supporting commercial teams through technical discovery, solution positioning, demonstrations, or complex customer evaluations. Strong communication, presentation, consultative selling, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to translate customer requirements and technical constraints into practical solutions and clearly communicate tradeoffs. Comfortable working with autonomy in a fast-paced, continuously evolving environment

jobgether-jobgether:lever:badb82be-eb7a-.title: Area Sales Manager, Patient Care Solutions
jobgether-jobgether:lever:badb82be-eb7a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Area Sales Manager, Patient Care Solutions based in India. This is a customer-facing sales leadership opportunity focused on growing a portfolio of patient care and medical technology solutions across Bihar and Jharkhand. The role will be responsible for developing the territory, identifying new business opportunities, and building strong relationships with healthcare customers and channel partners. You’ll work across products including patient monitors, ventilators, anesthesia workstations, and diagnostic cardiology solutions. Success will require strong commercial judgment, market knowledge, and the ability to translate customer needs into effective solutions. The position offers meaningful autonomy while working within established sales strategies and processes. Based out of Ranchi, you’ll play an important role in expanding access to advanced healthcare technologies across the region. Drive sales of patient care solutions, including patient monitors, ventilators, anesthesia workstations, diagnostic cardiology products, and related solutions across the assigned territory. Develop and execute territory sales strategies aligned with business objectives, market opportunities, customer needs, and sales targets. Build a deep understanding of the assigned geography, healthcare market, customer segments, product portfolio, competitive landscape, and key commercial drivers. Identify and develop new business opportunities while expanding relationships with existing customers. Build and maintain strong relationships with hospitals, healthcare providers, decision-makers, and channel partners. Work closely with channel partners to generate demand, strengthen market coverage, and accelerate business growth. Use market intelligence, customer insights, and commercial analysis to identify opportunities and inform sales decisions. Manage customer discussions throughout the sales cycle, from opportunity identification and solution positioning through negotiation and closure. Communicate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders regarding customer requirements, sales activities, and coordination needs. Apply sound judgment within established frameworks while taking ownership of territory-level decisions and commercial priorities. Support onboarding and development of newer team members by sharing product, market, and sales expertise. Plan, document, and execute sales and market-development programs while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction and business results. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college; an MBA is an advantage. Minimum 7 years of professional sales experience in medical equipment or healthcare technology. Strong track record in medical equipment sales, territory development, and new-business generation. Strong commercial acumen and demonstrated ability to identify, develop, and close new opportunities. Experience working effectively with channel partners and distributor networks. Experience in diagnostic imaging sales is preferred. Strong understanding of healthcare customers, medical technology markets, and relevant sales processes. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to assess customer and market challenges and develop practical solutions. Demonstrated ability to plan, document, market, and execute sales programs. Established project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities. Strong interpersonal skills, commercial confidence, and the ability to work effectively as an individual contributor. Willingness to work across the assigned territory and engage directly with customers and partners. Benefits:

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e53ee5eb-f7e2-.title: Business Operations Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e53ee5eb-f7e2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Operations Manager based in Switzerland. As Business Operations Manager, you’ll play a central role in ensuring commercial operations run smoothly across the EMEA region. You’ll act as the operational bridge between Commercial, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, HQ Operations, and external partners. Your scope will span the full commercial lifecycle, from quotations and orders through provisioning, invoicing, renewals, and partner operations. This is an independent, hands-on role where you’ll own issues, coordinate stakeholders, and drive solutions rather than simply provide administrative support. You’ll help identify operational bottlenecks and turn recurring challenges into scalable, standardized processes. Working in a fast-growing healthcare technology environment, you’ll have meaningful exposure to international markets and cross-functional initiatives. The role offers an opportunity to make a tangible impact on operational efficiency while helping support continued expansion across EMEA. Manage quotations and orders by preparing quotes and order forms, reviewing purchase orders, coordinating approvals, and ensuring accurate handovers between Commercial and operational teams. Coordinate order processing and license provisioning, ensuring customer and partner information is complete and resolving operational blockers efficiently. Support invoicing and accounts receivable activities by ensuring invoice readiness, coordinating with Finance, monitoring invoice status and overdue receivables, and resolving billing or documentation issues. Manage renewal operations by maintaining visibility of upcoming renewals, coordinating preparation across relevant teams and partners, and proactively tracking risks and outstanding actions. paradigm-paradigm:ashbyhq:c18c1fb4-9ad7-.title: Infrastructure Engineer, Applied AI
paradigm-paradigm:ashbyhq:c18c1fb4-9ad7-.description: INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER, APPLIED AI The Firm Paradigm https://www.paradigm.xyz/ is a San Francisco-based investment firm focused on frontier technologies across the globe, with over $11 billion in assets under management. We make investments in companies and protocols at all stages, ranging from early-stage venture financing rounds to growth equity to liquid assets. Paradigm was co-founded in 2018 and is co-led by Matt Huang https://www.linkedin.com/in/kmhuang/ and Alana Palmedo https://www.linkedin.com/in/askorniakoffpalmedo/. We’ve been hard at work investigating the world’s most beautiful technical problems since day one. Our research-driven approach helps us build relationships with founders and entrepreneurs, but it also reflects our broader goal of accelerating the progress of frontier technology. The Role Over the last eight years Paradigm has built some of the most used open-source software in the crypto industry, including Reth https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth and Foundry https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry. Earlier this year we published EVMBench https://paradigm.xyz/evmbench with OpenAI, launched Optimization Arena https://www.optimizationarena.com/ and hosted the Auto Research https://paradigm.xyz/automated-research-hackathon/ hackathon. More recently, we open-sourced Centaur https://www.paradigm.xyz/writing/open-sourcing-centaur-multiplayer-self-hosted-secure-agents, a self-hosted runtime for multiplayer AI agents, which we’ve been using to transform how we work at Paradigm and Tempo. All of these were done part-time by people on Paradigm’s Investing & Research team. This has made us realize that we are people-bound, not idea or impact bound. We need to grow our team to achieve our ambitions. We want to do three things: 1. Experiment aggressively. We will push the capabilities of models, harnesses and infrastructure to the limit in service of Paradigm’s broader goals in investing, research, and building. 2. Build in public. We will get our hands dirty building useful open-source products. 3. Invest. We will leverage our infrastructure - an area we think is still ripe for disruption with AI - to be better investors. By understanding infrastructure gaps experientially, we may incubate companies that will accrue value by addressing these gaps. As we deploy more long-running agentic capabilities, we may get into fundamental research, forecasting, model cost optimizations etc., but that is not our focus yet. We are looking for fearless engineers for this project who understand infrastructure, security, AI models, harnesses, and Slackbots. You will work directly with Georgios, Arjun, Matt Slipper, and the broader Paradigm team, alongside Tempo, and other companies that are themselves operating at the frontier. Your work will directly impact how Paradigm operates every day. If this sounds like you, reach out. Responsibilities - Control plane and durability: Own the core services that coordinate agent runs, keeping execution state durable and recoverable through restarts, failovers, and everything that goes wrong in production. - Execution runtime: Build and harden the sandboxed, Kubernetes-based runtime that isolates agent sessions, covering provisioning, lifecycle, and the network controls that make untrusted agent code safe to run. - Secrets and secure egress: Maintain the credential model that lets agents call third-party APIs without ever holding raw keys. - Reliability and observability: Own monitoring, alerting, incident response, and the failure-recovery behavior the system relies on. - Self-hosted deployment: Keep Centaur something any organization can run inside its own walls, with clean deployment, sane configuration, and painless upgrades. Qualifications and Experience - A track record of building world-class products - Experience applying modern AI and software systems to solve complex, ambiguous problems end-to-end - Comfortable navigating everything from foundational models to full-stack product delive
